# SOURCE Modeling Datasets

**Author:** M. El Aabaribaoune

## Purpose
Block 1 — SOURCE modeling datasets explaining the magnitude of the daily SMAP EnKF surface-soil-moisture update.

## Contents
Tabular Parquet data partitioned by year.
- `da_cdf/`: Derived from the DA-CDF experiment.
- `da_nocdf/`: Derived from the DA-NoCDF experiment.

## Conventions
Do not concatenate experiments into a single dataset.
Year-partition folders are mechanical partitions for PyArrow, not logical project directories requiring nested READMEs.
**Important:** Files in this directory are generated by project scripts. Do NOT manually modify generated Parquet products. Regenerate through the corresponding dataset builder scripts in `scripts/datasets/`.
